test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Somesh is a shopkeeper who gives two successive discounts on an umbrella marked Rs. 560. The first discount given is 17%. If the customer Mahesh pays Rs. 420 for the umbrella, then find the second discount given (correct to two places of decimals).
solution: Given: The first discount given is 17%. The marked price of the Umbrella = Rs. 560 Concept used: Selling price = Marked price × (100 - Discount)% Calculation: After 1st discount amount = 560 × 83%
